kaa.mistake_note_md: Qatań teńsizlikte shegaralıq pútin sandı qosıp jiberiw yamasa qatań emes teńsizlikte taslap jiberiw.

en.stem_md: How many integer solutions does the system $\begin{cases}4x-5<23\\5x-8\ge-3\end{cases}$ have?
en.solution_md: From the first $x<7$, from the second $x\ge1$. Integer solutions: $1,\ldots,6$ ($6$ of them). Answer: $6$.
en.mistake_note_md: Including the boundary integer for a strict inequality, or dropping it for a non-strict one.
